design.purpose: A warm two-tone scarf for one adult, about 88 cm long. Yarn quantity must be confirmed; if either skein runs short, finish at a colour boundary and weave in the end.

steps.c: Place green yarn and hook on work surface
Row 1: sc in 2nd ch, 13 sc total
Rows 2-10: ch 1, turn, 13 sc each row
Rows 11-20: ch 1, turn, 13 sc each row
Cut green yarn, leaving a 15 cm tail
Place blue yarn beside the scarf
Join blue, rows 21-30: 13 sc each row
Rows 31-40: ch 1, turn, 13 sc each row
Fasten off, cut blue leaving a 15 cm tail
Place the yarn needle ready for finishing
Weave the green tails into green stitches
Weave the blue tail into blue stitches
Trim woven tails flush with scissors
